# JohnNil.com

> বাংলাদেশের অল-ইন-ওয়ান ডিজিটাল প্ল্যাটফর্ম — আল-কুরআন ও নামাজের সময়, লাইভ আবহাওয়া, ফাইন্যান্স ম্যানেজার, লাইভ টিভি, অনলাইন শপ, আইটি সার্ভিস ও ৩০+ ফ্রি বাংলা টুল। An all-in-one Bangladeshi platform for Islamic resources, weather, finance, live TV, online shopping, IT services and 30+ free Bangla tools.

JohnNil.com is run from Dhaka, Bangladesh by John Nil. It serves Bangla and
English users with free daily-use tools, verified local information, digital
and physical products, and professional IT/digital services (website and app
development, design, digital marketing, CCTV, solar).

Contact: jnilbd@gmail.com · +880-1774-585757 · Dhaka, Bangladesh

## Products and services

- [Shop](/shop): Digital subscriptions, software, gadgets and physical products with cash on delivery, bKash and Nagad across Bangladesh.
- [Services](/services): Website development, mobile apps, graphic design, digital marketing, CCTV and solar installation.
- [Business tools](/business-tools): Invoice maker, courier charge calculator, profit calculator, stock management.
- [Portfolio](/portfolio): Completed websites, apps and design projects.
- [Appointment](/appointment): Book a consultation.
- [Marketplace](/marketplace): Free buy/sell classifieds.
- [Rentals](/rentals): House, flat, shop and equipment rental listings.

## Islamic

- [Al Quran](/quran): Full Quran with Arabic text, Bangla translation and audio recitation.
- [Namaz time](/namaz): Daily prayer times for Dhaka and all districts of Bangladesh.
- [Hadith](/hadith): Sahih hadith collections translated into Bangla.
- [Ruqyah](/ruqyah): Quran and Sunnah based ruqyah guide.

## Daily information

- [Weather](/weather): Live temperature, rain, storm and cyclone alerts for 64 districts.
- [Offers](/offers): GP, Robi, Banglalink, Airtel and Teletalk internet and bundle offers.
- [Free internet](/free-internet): Legal ways to get free MB and Wi-Fi in Bangladesh.
- [Live TV](/livetv): 2000+ live Bangla and international TV channels.
- [Newspapers](/newspapers): All Bangla newspapers and news portals in one place.
- [Stocks](/stocks): DSE and CSE indices, gold price and dollar rate.
- [Railway](/railway): Bangladesh Railway train schedule, fares and live tracking.
- [Politics](/politics): Bangladesh and world politics updates.
